name: Link (The Minish Cap) — Playable Character & Custom Attacks
author: HyruleChosenOne
tagline: Playable Link from The Minish Cap with 8-direction sprites, 5 custom attacks, dedicated custom VFX, and Four Sword Ultimate.
description: Brings Link from The Legend of Zelda: The Minish Cap into PokéBonk as a fully animated playable fighter in the Custom region (#2010). Features complete 8-direction walk, idle, attack, and hurt spritesheets, a Four Sword Red shiny variant, 5 signature Minish Cap custom attacks built with the Core Custom VFX engine, a custom Four Sword Hurricane Spin Ultimate, and 2 Hyrule Pokéball pickup items.
highlights: Full 8-direction GBA-style animated spritesheet plus Four Sword Red shiny variant
5 custom attacks: Picori Blade, Magical Boomerang, Gust Jar, Cane of Pacci, and Flame Lantern
5 custom GPU VFX presets showcasing dual-color slash arcs, returning crescents, gale waves, magic beams, and flame rings
Custom Ultimate: Four Sword Hurricane Spin with rune/petal shockwaves and slash bursts
2 custom Pokéball items: Gold Kinstone and Pegasus Boots
